newsitem.title: USA: US urges Americans to be cautious in Niger.
newsitem.headline: US urges Americans to be cautious in Niger.

text.p: The U.S. State Department on Tuesday warned Americans in Niger to take appropriate security precautions ahead of Saturday's election there.
"The possibility exists that campaign activities and demonstrations could turn unruly and result in some form of civil unrest," the U.S. Embassy in Niamey said.
The statement, released by the State Department in Washington, advised all Americans to avoid election gatherings and to be extra cautious in their daily activities.
U.S. citizens were urged to register with the U.S. Embassy in Niamey and to obtain updated information on travel and security in Niger.
The main opposition in the West African country is boycotting the parliamentary elections, accusing the president of rigging his own election in July after staging a coup.
